import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def preprocess_text(text):
    # Convert to lowercase only, retaining all other characters including punctuation
    return text.lower()


# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Preprocess text
train_df["text_clean"] = train_df["text"].apply(preprocess_text)
test_df["text_clean"] = test_df["text"].apply(preprocess_text)

# Map author labels for evaluation
author_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
train_labels = train_df["author"].map(author_map).values

# Split data (Hold-out validation)
X_train_text, X_val_text, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["text_clean"],
    train_labels,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_labels,
)

# Word Vectorizer
word_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=2,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    analyzer="word",
    lowercase=False,
)
X_train_word = word_vec.fit_transform(X_train_text)
X_val_word = word_vec.transform(X_val_text)
X_test_word = word_vec.transform(test_df["text_clean"])

# Character Vectorizer
char_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=3000, ngram_range=(2, 3), min_df=2, sublinear_tf=True, analyzer="char"
)
X_train_char = char_vec.fit_transform(X_train_text)
X_val_char = char_vec.transform(X_val_text)
X_test_char = char_vec.transform(test_df["text_clean"])

# Combine features
X_train = np.hstack([X_train_word.toarray(), X_train_char.toarray()])
X_val = np.hstack([X_val_word.toarray(), X_val_char.toarray()])
X_test = np.hstack([X_test_word.toarray(), X_test_char.toarray()])

# Train Logistic Regression Model with more features for better performance
lr_model = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=1000, random_state=42, solver="lbfgs", n_jobs=-1, C=10.0
)
lr_model.fit(X_train, y_train)
lr_pred_val = lr_model.predict_proba(X_val)
lr_pred_test = lr_model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Compute validation log loss on held-out set
val_loss = log_loss(y_val, lr_pred_val, labels=[0, 1, 2])
print(f"Validation Log Loss (held-out): {val_loss:.6f}")

# Prepare submission
submission_data = test_df[["id"]].copy()
prob_cols = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]

# Map class indices to author names based on training labels
# The columns order should match the class order: EAP(0), HPL(1), MWS(2)
submission_data["EAP"] = lr_pred_test[:, 0]
submission_data["HPL"] = lr_pred_test[:, 1]
submission_data["MWS"] = lr_pred_test[:, 2]

# Reorder columns to match sample_submission exactly
submission_data = submission_data[sample_sub.columns.tolist()]

# Clip probabilities to avoid log function extremes
for col in submission_data.columns[1:]:
    submission_data[col] = submission_data[col].clip(1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Save submission
submission_data.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission rows: {len(submission_data)}")
print(f"Validation metric: {val_loss:.6f}")
